_comment: Authoritative heat relief (#67, #68). Changing any value is a gameplay change: bump WireCodec.BUILD and ship a matching hosted server release. Heat is the shared 0..100 heat; seconds and game metres.

spree._comment: Each elimination vents heat_per_kill heat plus heat_per_combo for every earlier kill still inside window_seconds (the combo, capped at max_combo), and triples ordinary cooling (boost_multiplier) for boost_seconds, so a spree can keep going.

zones._comment: Cooling zones: circles of radius metres at fraction of the arena half extent on the four axes, reaching height metres above their floor point. A bot inside sheds cooling_per_second heat even while its weapons run.

coolant._comment: Coolant canisters: count pickup points spread on a ring at fraction of the arena half extent between the spawn bearings; each vents heat on collection and returns after respawn_seconds.
